matches.text:
# Frequently asked questions

## When are you open?

- April to October: every day, 08:00–20:00.
- November to March: Monday to Saturday, 09:00–17:00. Closed on Sundays.
- Closed on 25 and 26 December and on 1 January.

Bikes can only be picked up and returned while the shop is open.

## Where are you?

At the main entrance of the Riverside Park, next to the tram stop "Park Nadrzeczny".

## What do I need to rent a bike?

An ID card or a passport, and a payment card or a voucher for the deposit. We do not take deposits in cash.

## How can I pay?

By card or with a CityWheels voucher, online or in the shop. In the shop you can also pay the rental in cash, but not the deposit.

## Are there age limits?

- Kids bikes: for children from 6 to 12 years old, rented by a parent or guardian.
- City bikes: from 13 years old. Riders under 18 need a parent or guardian to sign the rental.
- Electric bikes: from 16 years old. Riders under 18 need a parent or guardian to sign the rental.

## Do I have to wear a helmet?

Helmets are free and we recommend them for everyone. They are required for riders under 16.

## Can I take my dog?

Dogs are not allowed in bike baskets or child seats.

## Can I take the bike on a train or outside the city?

Yes, inside the country. Taking a bike abroad is not allowed.

## What if the bike breaks or I have an accident?

Stop riding, make sure you are safe, and call the staff at +48 000 000 000. Do not try to repair an electric bike yourself.

## What if the bike is stolen or lost?

Report it to the police and call the staff at once. The staff decide about the deposit after reading the police report.

## Do you sell bikes?

No. We only rent bikes.

# Cancellations and refunds

## Cancelling a booking

A customer can cancel a booking with the status `confirmed`. How much of the rental price comes back depends on how long before the start of the rental the booking is cancelled:

| Cancelled | Refund of the rental price |
| --- | --- |
| 48 hours or more before the start | 100% |
| Less than 48 hours, but 24 hours or more before the start | 50% |
| Less than 24 hours before the start | 0% |

- The booking fee is never refunded.
- The deposit is always refunded in full when a booking is cancelled.
- Bookings with the status `in_progress`, `completed` or `cancelled` cannot be cancelled, and nothing is refunded for them.

## How the money comes back

- Bookings paid by card are refunded to the same card within 5 working days.
- Bookings paid with a voucher are refunded as a new voucher of the same value, never as money. The deposit is refunded the same way it was paid.

## Changing a booking

The dates or the bike type of a `confirmed` booking can be changed for free up to 24 hours before the start, if bikes are available. Later changes are not possible: the customer has to cancel and book again.

## Bad weather

If the weather service issues a storm warning for the day of the rental, the customer may get a full refund. The staff decide each case. Customers have to contact the staff for this.

## Contact the staff

- Email: help@citywheels.example
- Phone: +48 000 000 000, every day while the shop is open
